popup.title: Show as a popup
popup.description: Open the form in a popup on your own website instead of placing it in the page. Choose when it opens, then copy the code.

triggers.scroll_up: When the visitor scrolls back up

triggerHints.delay: Opens a set time after the page loads.
triggerHints.scroll_down: Opens once the visitor has scrolled this far down the page.
triggerHints.scroll_up: Opens when the visitor has read down the page and then scrolls back up, a sign they may be leaving.
triggerHints.click: Opens only when someone clicks a button or link that carries the code shown below.

positions.center: Centre of the screen, dimming the page
positions.bottom_right: Bottom corner, without dimming the page

popup.daysHint: 0 shows it on every visit. Once someone sends the form, it never shows to them again.
popup.note: Add your website to Allowed websites below first, or the popup will stay blank.

code.title: Popup code
code.description: Paste this where the popup should load, usually just before the closing body tag.

button.title: A button that opens it
button.description: Add this to any page to let people open the popup themselves. It works with every trigger.
